verdict.rationale: xAI docs describe a default 30-day retention policy with a self-serve Zero Data Retention (ZDR) option that ensures prompts/outputs are 'never persisted to disk,' toggleable per team, with a response header confirming ZDR status — this strongly implies data isn't retained for training when enabled, but the docs never explicitly state a distinct 'do not train on my data' opt-out separate from retention, nor clarify default training behavior for non-ZDR users. Missing for 10: an explicit training-data-usage policy statement, opt-out toggle independent of retention, and third-party/community confirmation that ZDR actually prevents training use.
